verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API plus TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs for interacting with the Connect service. It also documents a public remote MCP endpoint (`https://remote.mcp.pipedream.net/v3`) with explicit auth and project headers, and a proxy for calling endpoints that have no pre-built tool. Probes confirm machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown pages) suited to AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: detailed REST API reference coverage (endpoints, operations) beyond a one-line mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
